topic: displaySafe lets line and paragraph separators through
detail: From SP-054's security review (Low). OrchKit's displaySafe escapes control and format characters but not U+2028/U+2029 (Zl/Zp), so a command, draft value or message could fake extra lines in a row; long runs of combining marks are not capped either. It is a shared helper used by every pane, so it was left for its own change.
